content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV announced a series of updates, including the premiere date for the fourth season of Silo (《末日地堡》).

Silo season 4 will debut in summer 2027, and will also be the show's final season.

Silo season 3 is currently airing (available to watch here), with new episodes releasing weekly until September 4.

However, at this past weekend's San Diego Comic-Con, Apple surprised Silo fans alongside news about several other sci-fi series.

Silo season 4 will arrive next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement Apple TV posted on platform X:

In the streaming era, a series can sometimes take years to release a new season, especially for a large-scale sci-fi production like Silo.

Apple, however, has been proactive, renewing some of its series early to speed up their return. Take Silo as an example: seasons 3 and 4 were developed simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

We still have six weeks to savor the afterglow of the new season of Silo. But after this season ends, fans won't have to wait long, because season 4 will follow shortly after.

What are your thoughts on Silo season 3 so far? Feel free to share in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, but you can get a discount by subscribing through the Apple One bundle.
